anyOf.description: content path of a scene asset (no extension)

defaultScene.description: the scene the game opens with; null when the root renderer draws everything (no scene); content path of a scene asset (no extension)

type.description: the name the game registered its renderer under (loadGameSettings renderers)

props.description: values keyed by name; the keys and value kinds the file already has

renderer.description: the compositor root when the game draws with its own renderer: its registered type name and properties

defaultBackBufferSize.description: the design resolution (desktop Stride opens its window this size); unit: px
